description: This file defines the Shape class which models a generic 'shape' in the AWS SDK's API modeling system. It includes methods to create specific shape instances based on a definition, retrieve the shape's type and name, and access context parameters.

classes.name: Shape
classes.description: Represents a modeled shape in the AWS API schema, providing methods for instantiation and attribute access.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a specific shape class based on the provided definition and shape map.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the shape from the definition.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the shape from the definition.

methods.name: getContextParam
methods.description: Retrieves the context parameter associated with this shape.
